_about: Per building texture exceptions to the automatic winter roof snow (scripts/season_roofs.py, season_recolor.py). Key = texture name (Season Preview > Buildings shows it). Options: snow (false = no snow on this texture), shades (how many snow colours, default 4), keep (colours as rrggbb that stay as they are), lum ([darkest, brightest] snow brightness, default [0.7, 1.0]), trim (false = grey/white trim and the dark outline get snow too), awnings ('roof' = low faces facing up are roof, 'wall' = they block it; default: sloped ones are neither), grow (texels the roof may spread into same colours, default 2), gaps (false = don't fill small gaps), note (why). Hand-painted textures in data/seasons/roofs/ go on top of all this.
